header: A contact who already knows your plant
author: Ingrid Halmweger
role: Head of service, Vienna and Lower Austria
text: Ingrid has planned maintenance schedules here since 2011 and looks after the housing associations herself. Ask her what an existing contract covers.
note: Available Monday to Thursday 07:30 to 16:30 and Friday until 12:30. Outside these hours, call the breakdown line: 0800 24 24 90.
